scope: Actual private sizing form, transparent garment-comparison rules, manual purchase options and customer isolation. No predictive body-fit or synthetic review claims.

checks.name: Default private profile preserves the prepared 66 recommendation
Sizing form labels garment width separately from body circumference
Review evidence remains overall product aggregate without fabricated review portraits
Height alone is saved as context and never changes recommended size
Invalid height is blocked by actual form validity and never saved
Half-size preference changes the displayed recommendation and recommended option badge
Saving a new recommendation does not change the selected purchase size
Manual option selection preserves unsaved profile edits
Owned garment width compares against real product 47.5 cm option
Relaxed fit uses the saved garment measurement to suggest the next option
Director public payload and another customer never receive A profile fields
Director DOM excludes raw private height and garment measurements
Purchase flow follows manual 55 option rather than automatic 77 recommendation
Valid but out-of-table garment width produces manual checking with no invented size
Refresh preserves saved private inputs recommendation and manual option
Customer B starts with its independent unchanged profile
Saving B profile does not overwrite A measurements
Returning to A restores its own saved recommendation
Private profile form fits mobile without horizontal overflow
Delayed private save cannot reopen or overwrite another customer screen
Reset clears saved profiles and restores default recommendation 66
No uncaught browser errors during sizing changes and customer transitions
